description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'TimeAtWorkLastActionDetails' used within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, specifically within the dashboard plugin. The class encapsulates details of the last action taken at the user's time at work, including properties like state, relevant timestamps, and timezone offset. It provides constructor and getter methods for these properties.

classes.name: TimeAtWorkLastActionDetails
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object class representing details of the last user action related to time at work, including state, timestamps, and timezone information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize all properties related to the last action details.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state/status of the last action.

methods.name: getUtcDate
methods.description: Returns the UTC date of the last action.

methods.name: getUtcTime
methods.description: Returns the UTC time of the last action.

methods.name: getUserDate
methods.description: Returns the user-specific date of the last action.

methods.name: getUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user-specific time of the last action.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset at the time of the last action.
